verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Browser Use is fundamentally a natural-language, one-shot task/agent model (client.runs.create('Find the top HN story'), session reuse for multi-run continuity) plus a Python library and MCP server, but nothing documents native workflow primitives like loops, conditionals, or parameterized templates as an alternative to prompting — any looping would require the engineer to hand-write it in surrounding Python code, which the product itself doesn't provide as a feature.
